slots.observable_law: Coerce a valid pathname designator to a pathname object without opening the designated file.
slots.positive_witness: A previously constructed pathname remains a pathname after coercion.
slots.negative_falsifier: Opening the designated file or fabricating a different identity is not required.

slots.observable_law: Construct a pathname from explicitly supplied components and defaults only for omitted ones.
slots.positive_witness: An explicitly supplied name overrides a different name from defaults.
slots.negative_falsifier: Defaults replace an explicitly supplied component.

slots.observable_law: Test whether the object is a pathname rather than merely a string that can designate one.
slots.positive_witness: MAKE-PATHNAME result is a pathname; the string denoting it is not itself a pathname.
slots.negative_falsifier: Accept every path-looking string as a pathname object.

slots.observable_law: Extract the host component of a pathname designator, preserving the distinction between its components.
slots.positive_witness: For a pathname with a distinct host value, return that exact component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different component in place of host.

slots.observable_law: Extract the device component of a pathname designator, preserving the distinction between its components.
slots.positive_witness: For a pathname with a distinct device value, return that exact component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different component in place of device.

slots.observable_law: Extract the directory component of a pathname designator, preserving the distinction between its components.
slots.positive_witness: For a pathname with a distinct directory value, return that exact component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different component in place of directory.

slots.observable_law: Extract the name component of a pathname designator, preserving the distinction between its components.
slots.positive_witness: For a pathname with a distinct name value, return that exact component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different component in place of name.

slots.observable_law: Extract the type component of a pathname designator, preserving the distinction between its components.
slots.positive_witness: For a pathname with a distinct type value, return that exact component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different component in place of type.

slots.observable_law: Extract the version component of a pathname designator, preserving the distinction between its components.
slots.positive_witness: For a pathname with a distinct version value, return that exact component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different component in place of version.

slots.observable_law: Convert a valid logical-pathname designator into the logical pathname value without resolving or opening a host file.
slots.positive_witness: A logical pathname designator of a defined logical host converts to the corresponding logical pathname.
slots.negative_falsifier: Treat an arbitrary physical pathname as a valid logical-host pathname.

slots.observable_law: Check for wildcard components in a pathname globally or in one designated component.
slots.positive_witness: A wildcard name causes the name-specific test to be true; a concrete type-only field remains false.
slots.negative_falsifier: A wildcard in the name causes the type-only test to be true.

slots.observable_law: Build a two-way stream taking input from the designated input stream and directing output to the designated output stream.
slots.positive_witness: Input from I is readable while output reaches O.
slots.negative_falsifier: Reject input/output arguments of incompatible stream capability.

slots.observable_law: Return the input component stream of the two-way stream.
slots.positive_witness: Two-way constructed from I,O returns I for input query.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return O for the input query.

slots.observable_law: Return the output component stream of the two-way stream.
slots.positive_witness: Two-way constructed from I,O returns O for output query.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return I for the output query.

slots.observable_law: Return the input component of an echo stream.
slots.positive_witness: Echo stream constructed from I,O has input component I.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return O when asked for echo input.

slots.observable_law: Return the output component of an echo stream.
slots.positive_witness: Echo stream constructed from I,O has output component O.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return I when asked for echo output.

slots.observable_law: Construct a stream that reads from I and echoes read input to O while also accepting direct output to O.
slots.positive_witness: Reading characters from I echoes them to O in their original order.
slots.negative_falsifier: Echo each read character twice or drop direct output.

slots.observable_law: Return the remaining associated input streams of a concatenated stream.
slots.positive_witness: Construct from I,J and inspect the associated sequence before reads.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return an output stream not associated with the concatenation.

slots.observable_law: Make one input stream that consumes supplied input streams successively.
slots.positive_witness: Two character input streams 'a' then 'b' read as 'ab'.
slots.negative_falsifier: Read from the second input before consuming the first.

slots.observable_law: Return accumulated output of a string-output stream and clear its accumulated buffer.
slots.positive_witness: Write 'abc'; first query yields 'abc', next yields empty string.
slots.negative_falsifier: Second query repeats the previously removed characters.

slots.observable_law: Return an input stream emitting the specified substring in order, then end-of-file.
slots.positive_witness: Input 'abcdef' with start 1,end 4 emits 'bcd'.
slots.negative_falsifier: Include characters outside [start,end) or recycle on EOF.

slots.observable_law: Return an output stream whose written characters are subsequently retrievable as an ordered string.
slots.positive_witness: Writing 'hi' yields 'hi' on get-output-stream-string.
slots.negative_falsifier: Lose the order of written characters.

slots.observable_law: Return a complete namestring representation of an explicit pathname under an explicitly named host/profile.
slots.positive_witness: A physical pathname maps to a full namestring under that host's conventions.
slots.negative_falsifier: Require a universal Unix slash representation for every host.

slots.observable_law: Return namestring for just filename name, type and version components of a pathname.
slots.positive_witness: File component rendering excludes directory and host components.
slots.negative_falsifier: Include a different directory as part of file-name-only projection.

slots.observable_law: Return pathname directory portion in the host's canonical namestring convention.
slots.positive_witness: Directory-only rendering represents the directory components.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return the filename portion in place of the directory.

slots.observable_law: Return pathname host portion as a namestring (or nil where not representable).
slots.positive_witness: A pathname with a designated host produces that host's rendered component.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a directory path instead of the host.

slots.observable_law: Parse an explicit namestring substring and report pathname plus terminating index; explicit logical host syntax must not be guessed.
slots.positive_witness: A logical pathname with a matching host parses into that host's logical pathname.
slots.negative_falsifier: Accept contradictory manifest and explicitly requested hosts.

slots.observable_law: Apply ordered logical-host translation rules to a logical pathname until a physical pathname results.
slots.positive_witness: Matching translation of a logical host to a physical host produces the mapped physical pathname.
slots.negative_falsifier: Silently succeed when no translation rule matches; host-defined lookup is not assumed universal.

slots.observable_law: Translate an explicit source pathname matching FROM-WILDCARD into TO-WILDCARD with corresponding wildcard substitutions.
slots.positive_witness: An explicit wildcard source name captured by FROM appears in the substituted TO name.
slots.negative_falsifier: Treat a non-matching source as an ordinary matched pathname.

slots.observable_law: Return the offending stream recorded in a stream-error condition.
slots.positive_witness: A stream-error condition generated for stream S exposes S via STREAM-ERROR-STREAM.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return an unrelated stream not referenced by the condition.

slots.observable_law: Mark an accessible symbol external in its target package.
slots.positive_witness: FIND-SYMBOL reports :EXTERNAL for an exported symbol.
slots.negative_falsifier: Exporting a symbol silently changes its identity.

slots.observable_law: Look up a symbol by exact name and return both its identity and :INTERNAL, :EXTERNAL, :INHERITED or absence.
slots.positive_witness: After INTERN of 'X' in P, FIND-SYMBOL of X in P reports an accessible symbol and status.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a symbol from an unrelated package with the wrong status.

slots.observable_law: Resolve a registered package by its primary name, nickname, or package designator.
slots.positive_witness: A registered package nickname resolves to the same package object.
slots.negative_falsifier: Invent a new package if the name is not registered.

slots.observable_law: Collect interned symbols whose names exactly equal the requested string across known packages.
slots.positive_witness: An interned X is returned among same-named symbols; a different name is excluded.
slots.negative_falsifier: Include a symbol whose name does not match.

slots.observable_law: Make an existing symbol present in a target package without changing symbol identity.
slots.positive_witness: Import S into P; FIND-SYMBOL returns that very S.
slots.negative_falsifier: Silently replace a conflicting distinct symbol of the same name.

slots.observable_law: Return the set/list of currently registered package objects.
slots.positive_witness: After MAKE-PACKAGE of fresh P, the resulting P appears in the registry.
slots.negative_falsifier: Include a package that has never been registered.

slots.observable_law: Change a package's name/nicknames while preserving the package identity.
slots.positive_witness: A fresh nickname resolves to the renamed package object.
slots.negative_falsifier: Rename creates an unrelated package and loses existing symbols.

slots.observable_law: Establish a local symbol of a specified name as a shadowing identity, preventing same-name inherited ambiguity.
slots.positive_witness: A shadowing name remains locally accessible despite used package exports.
slots.negative_falsifier: An inherited conflicting symbol overrides the shadowing symbol.

slots.observable_law: Import the specified symbol as a shadowing symbol, using its exact identity.
slots.positive_witness: A target package resolves the given imported S rather than a conflicting inherited symbol.
slots.negative_falsifier: Create a fresh unrelated symbol instead of importing S.

slots.observable_law: Delete a registered package from the package registry according to the defined package lifecycle.
slots.positive_witness: FIND-PACKAGE no longer resolves a successfully deleted package by its former registered name.
slots.negative_falsifier: Delete an unrelated package while leaving the requested one registered.

slots.observable_law: Create a new package registered under a distinct given name with specified initial use relations.
slots.positive_witness: A fresh name resolves to the created package after the call.
slots.negative_falsifier: Create a second conflicting package under an already registered name without error.

slots.observable_law: Change an accessible external symbol in a package to internal status without removing its identity.
slots.positive_witness: Previously external S is still present but reports :INTERNAL after UNEXPORT.
slots.negative_falsifier: UNEXPORT silently removes S from the package.

slots.observable_law: Remove a symbol from its package's present-symbol set, respecting shadowing and inherited-name behavior.
slots.positive_witness: UNINTERN of sole local S removes that local presence.
slots.negative_falsifier: Remove unrelated symbols or pretend the symbol still belongs to the same present-symbol set.

slots.observable_law: Remove one use/inheritance relation without erasing symbols physically present in the target package.
slots.positive_witness: After UNUSE-PACKAGE, unrelated locally present symbols remain accessible.
slots.negative_falsifier: Remove all local symbols when removing only one used package.

slots.observable_law: Add a package use relation, making its external symbols accessible subject to name-conflict checking.
slots.positive_witness: The external X of used P becomes inherited in an otherwise conflict-free target.
slots.negative_falsifier: Silently resolve two conflicting inherited identities as though they were the same symbol.

slots.observable_law: Return a package's primary registered name.
slots.positive_witness: After MAKE-PACKAGE with primary name P, PACKAGE-NAME identifies P.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a nickname instead of the primary name.

slots.observable_law: Return the alternative names registered for a package.
slots.positive_witness: The nicknames supplied at creation appear in PACKAGE-NICKNAMES.
slots.negative_falsifier: Replace the primary name with a nickname in the primary-name field.

slots.observable_law: Return the symbols explicitly recorded as shadowing in one package.
slots.positive_witness: After SHADOW of X, the package shadowing set contains that local X.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return an unrelated imported symbol as a shadowing member.

slots.observable_law: Return the packages whose external symbols a target package uses.
slots.positive_witness: USE-PACKAGE of P into Q makes P appear in Q's use-list.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a package that Q does not use.

slots.observable_law: Return the reverse relation: packages that use this package.
slots.positive_witness: After Q uses P, Q appears in PACKAGE-USED-BY-LIST of P.
slots.negative_falsifier: Confuse used-by with P's own use-list.

slots.observable_law: Recognize package objects as distinct from package names/string designators.
slots.positive_witness: MAKE-PACKAGE result is PACKAGEP true; string containing its name is not a package object.
slots.negative_falsifier: Treat any package-name string as an actual package object.

slots.observable_law: Extract the package referent recorded in a package-error condition.
slots.positive_witness: A package-error condition tied to package P exposes its recorded package referent.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return a different unrelated package as the error referent.

slots.observable_law: Copy a readtable's character syntax and macro associations into a separately mutable target/readtable.
slots.positive_witness: Mutating a copied readtable does not mutate the source table's mapping.
slots.negative_falsifier: A copy shares writable syntax associations with the original.

slots.observable_law: Recognize an actual readtable object, not any string or arbitrary datum.
slots.positive_witness: COPY-READTABLE produces an object for which READTABLEP is true.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return true for an ordinary character or integer.

slots.observable_law: Read or set the specified readtable case-conversion mode while preserving mode distinctions.
slots.positive_witness: A table configured :PRESERVE reports :PRESERVE; :UPCASE reports :UPCASE.
slots.negative_falsifier: Read a different case mode than the table's current mode.

slots.observable_law: Return the macro-character function and nonterminating flag for an explicit character and readtable.
slots.positive_witness: A character registered with SET-MACRO-CHARACTER is retrieved with its flag.
slots.negative_falsifier: Forget the nonterminating flag or return a function from a different character.

slots.observable_law: Look up the dispatch function assigned to an explicit macro dispatch-char/sub-char pair in a readtable.
slots.positive_witness: A function installed for (#,{) is retrieved for the same pair.
slots.negative_falsifier: Return that function for an unrelated dispatch sub-character.
